newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bogota stock exchange gets new president.
newsitem.headline: Bogota stock exchange gets new president.

text.p: Colombia's deputy defense minister, Augusto Acosta, was appointed president of the Bogota stock exchange Thursday, the top official on the exchange's board of directors said.
Mauricio Botero, the board's chairman, said Acosta had been selected to replace Carlos Caballero, an economist who announced plans to step down in March after nearly 2-1/2 years on the job.

Acosta, a lawyer, served on the board of directors of Colombia's National Banking Association before taking up his post as No. 2 at the Defense Ministry. Botero said Acosta would take up his new job as soon as his replacement was named at the ministry.
